simd-adler32 0.3.10 from crates.io, MIT.
Upstream source commit d93164f98d7fe2daf883f2e1bec82778dd26199a.
Published archive SHA-256 3a219298ac11a56ea9a6d2120044824d6f01aeb034955e7af7bc16858527deea.

The local fork keeps streaming, seeded, one-shot, and no_std checksum APIs.
It delegates to adler2 2.0.1 and omits the hidden architecture-specific
implementations. The portable scalar helper remains available. The nightly
feature name is retained for dependency compatibility.
